item.title: When $8 Becomes $240
item.description: We all know that language models produce different results to each time. But did you know how much that can cause the COSTS to vary?
item.dc:creator: Example Author
item.content:encoded: @demian_ai dug up an arXiv paper: researchers ran an identical agentic task many times over with the same model, prompt, context window, and tool stack. The bill came back at $8 on one run and $240 on another, a 30x spread on fixed inputs.

item.title: Your Agent Hallucinates Packages. Hackers Just Weaponised That.
item.description: Supply chain attacks now exploit LLM mistakes by design, not by accident. We’ve seen this before with hallucinated URLs in SEO.
